evals.prompt: Add Arabic captions to this English video and send me the finished MP4 link: https://example.com/video.mp4
evals.expected_output: A verified MP4 with burned-in Arabic captions delivered as a shareable URL.
assertions: Uses the explicitly requested Arabic language and URL delivery without asking for those choices again
Asks whether the user wants the current choices persisted before writing preferences
Downloads only the requested video without a playlist
Uses timestamped multilingual transcription and Arabic translation
Visually inspects the rendered captions before uploading
Returns an HTTP(S) link to the generated MP4
Announces and schedules cleanup only after successful delivery

evals.expected_output: The agent asks whether to deliver a file or URL, then produces a verified MP4 preserving the Spanish video's timing and audio with readable Arabic captions.
assertions: Asks for file or URL delivery when neither the request nor saved preferences specify it
Does not overwrite or delete the local source file
Transcribes the non-English source with the multilingual model
Uses the requested, saved, or default font size in that priority order
Probes and visually checks the final MP4 before delivery
Deletes only the marked generated work directory after the cleanup grace period
